origin: companion to discussion-review-holds-until-map-moves — the backoff's escape hatch: a review the user explicitly asks for is its own trigger, dispatched --final past the movement gate the automatic path respects, with the safety conditions (drained store, empty queues) still holding; pins that a quiet topic never refuses the user (design/review-cadence.md C5)
conduct: The user returns with one intent: before taking the retry thread any further, they want a fresh pair of eyes over the whole document — they open by asking directly for a review of the discussion as it stands. They decide nothing, settle nothing, and add no new material; if asked whether anything changed for them, nothing has. Once the review is dispatched and announced they acknowledge and go quiet.

stubs.discussion-review-clean: when the engine records a dispatch of kind review — write the content to the path the dispatch response returned

calls_in_order: agent dispatch pay discussion pay --kind review --final
